receipts.proposedDefault: Three renameable custom presets plus a Manage/Rename tile
receipts.rationale: The request permits three or four presets; the proposed layout is planning input only until explicitly frozen.

receipts.proposedDefault: Adrenaline uses x1.10 damage, x1.10 movement, x0.90 reload duration, and does not stack
receipts.rationale: Exact modifier arithmetic and composition order affect shared combat authority and require a frozen value.

receipts.proposedDefault: Nuke is care-package-only at exactly 1 percent; Drone Swarm is the selectable top tier
receipts.rationale: Selectable roster and care-only eligibility alter progression, UI, probability, and release compatibility.
AI versus player control changes authority, controls, camera, network state, and calibration scope.

receipts.proposedDefault: Care packages are enemy-stealable and the owner captures faster
receipts.rationale: The ownership and theft rule controls interaction admission, timing, contention, and reward attribution.

receipts.proposedDefault: The operator body is immobile and vulnerable while piloting a drone
receipts.rationale: Body behavior changes possession authority, risk, exit handling, death, and disconnect recovery.

receipts.proposedDefault: Carry two frags, one smoke, and one flash; smoke affects all; friendly flash is reduced
receipts.rationale: Carry limits and friendly effects change inventory schema, balance, UI, and multiplayer semantics.

receipts.proposedDefault: The host assigns one fixed crossbow detonation tick at launch; bolts stick to world or actors and deal modest direct plus small blast damage
receipts.rationale: Fuse origin, stick targets, and damage values determine replay-safe projectile state and balance.

receipts.proposedDefault: Nuke Town and RustRig are outdoor shed maps; Terminal apron requires an explicit classification decision
receipts.rationale: Outdoor classification controls shed count, flight navigation, placement, and per-arena QA scope.

receipts.proposedDefault: Use 2560x1440 for primary play, 1600x900 for deterministic capture, and optional 4K for Max review
receipts.rationale: Performance thresholds are meaningless until resolution, preset, scene, adapter, and sample protocol are frozen.

receipts.proposedDefault: Use original in-game display names and identities rather than real-world branded names
receipts.rationale: Naming affects originality, asset briefs, UI copy, provenance, and release risk.

receipts.proposedDefault: Ship only original or compatible-license audio and music with complete provenance
receipts.rationale: Audio sourcing must be fixed before production to prevent unshippable or unverifiable content.

receipts.proposedDefault: Freeze the complete killstreak roster, costs, alternatives, duplication, earning and carry rules, care-pool eligibility, chopper calibration, sensor envelope, and Carpet Bomber anchor semantics before support schema work
receipts.rationale: Support schemas and every killstreak slice depend on one complete product and calibration contract.

receipts.proposedDefault: Name the photosensitive-flash standard and freeze numeric frequency, area, luminance, reduced-motion, reduced-flash, reduced-sensory, and manual-setting precedence
receipts.rationale: Feedback and flash effects cannot be safely implemented against an unnamed or non-numeric accessibility target.

receipts.proposedDefault: Keep Pass 62 as an immutable offline or reconstructible oracle unless a dedicated direct public path is deliberately retained
receipts.rationale: The benchmark availability policy affects rollback topology, release-shell routes, and public claims.
receipts.freezeNoLaterThan: Before F00 rollback/release topology and RL01 release shell
